d: Journeying from Mexico back home to West Texas, mercenary Tom Buchanan takes a break for the night in the border town of Agry. He soon discovers that almost every resident -- from the crooked sheriff to the shifty-eyed innkeeper -- is a member of the prominent Agry family. When he arrives in a small town near the robbery, he senses that the thieves may be living there.
